values.Description:
Groom To Be Decoration Kit (47 Pieces) - Bachelor Party Set

This Groom To Be decoration kit contains 47 pieces for a bachelor party, groom welcome and pre wedding celebration. The black and gold colour setup combines balloons, a Groom To Be foil banner, star shape foil balloons, silver colour fringe foil curtains and a Groom To Be sash for a coordinated groom celebration display.

Use the kit for room decoration at home, hotel room decoration, banquet hall decoration or a party venue backdrop. The wall pieces create a central photo area while the balloons can be arranged around the display, and the included sash gives the groom a matching wearable piece for celebration photos.

WHAT YOU GET (47 Pieces)
20 Black Colour Balloons
20 Gold Colour Balloons
2 Star Shape Gold Foil Balloons
1 Groom To Be Foil Banner
2 Silver Colour Fringe Foil Curtains
1 Groom To Be Sash
1 Glue Tape

KEY FEATURES
47 Pieces - Brings the main wall decor balloons backdrop pieces and sash into one pack
Groom To Be Foil Banner - Places the celebration wording at the centre of the wall display
Silver Colour Fringe Foil Curtains - Form a reflective photo backdrop behind the groom setup
Star Shape Gold Foil Balloons - Add foil shapes beside the letter banner and balloon arrangement
Groom To Be Sash - Gives the groom a wearable piece that matches the celebration theme

PERFECT FOR
Bachelor Party
Groom Welcome
Pre Wedding Groom Decoration
Hotel Room Groom Setup
Home Groom Celebration Decor
Banquet Hall Groom Decoration
Groom Photo Booth Backdrop
Bachelor Party Room Decoration

WHY CHOOSE THIS KIT

The 47 piece pack combines black and gold colour balloons with the main Groom To Be wall wording, star shape foil balloons, silver colour fringe foil curtains and a matching sash. This makes it suitable when you want the wall backdrop and wearable groom accessory together instead of selecting each decoration group separately.

For setup, first choose the wall area for the backdrop. Fix the silver colour fringe foil curtains to create the background, then position the Groom To Be foil banner where the wording stays visible. Inflate the black and gold colour balloons and the star shape gold foil balloons, arrange them around the banner and backdrop, and use the included glue tape where suitable for the decoration. The sash can be worn by the groom during the party and while taking photos.

The finished arrangement uses black and gold colour balloons around gold foil elements with silver colour fringe behind them. It works for a groom welcome at home, a bachelor party in a hotel room, a pre wedding gathering in a banquet hall or a groom photo booth backdrop at a party venue. The separate balloon colours let you distribute black and gold colour balloons across both sides of the wall display while keeping the Groom To Be foil banner as the main wording.

Start by fixing the fringe foil curtains and banner then inflate and arrange the balloons around the backdrop.
